primary_question: At a fixed frozen NoMaD checkpoint and candidate count K=8, do low-NFE DDIM, classifier-free guidance, or ranked test-time selection change closed-loop navigation success and efficiency relative to DDPM-10?

randomization.goal_seed_note: The frozen topomap endpoint is used, so goal_seed is recorded but does not vary the goal.
randomization.pairing: Every configuration and stabilizer stratum uses the identical scene/goal/seed keys.

success.definition: Robot planar position enters the frozen goal radius before timeout and without a terminal fall.

failure_taxonomy.collision: At least one robot-to-wall or robot-to-obstacle contact; floor and robot self-contacts are excluded.
failure_taxonomy.fall: The simulator platform fall detector triggers after its built-in grace period.
failure_taxonomy.stuck: The frozen stuck detector triggers at least once; recovery does not erase the event.
failure_taxonomy.intervention: Any keyboard, estop, external exit, or manual state intervention occurs.
failure_taxonomy.crash: An uncaught exception, process signal, or nonzero exit occurs; a failed record remains in the denominator.
failure_taxonomy.infrastructure_invalid: A pre-run immutable-input/schema/device check fails before simulation starts. It is retained but excluded from scientific metrics and rerun only after the infrastructure fault is fixed.

latency.cuda_synchronization: torch.cuda.synchronize immediately before and after timed sampler calls

exclusion_and_retry_rules.outcome_exclusions: None. Successes, navigation failures, falls, collisions, stuck episodes, timeouts, and crashes remain in the planned-trial denominator.
exclusion_and_retry_rules.infrastructure_exclusions: Only infrastructure_invalid trials are excluded from scientific estimates; reason and original record are retained.
exclusion_and_retry_rules.retry: Never overwrite. Resume creates a new attempt linked to the same trial key; the first scientifically valid completed attempt is primary, and every attempt remains auditable.
exclusion_and_retry_rules.scene_gate: Before configuration comparison, baseline-only or method-blind calibration may reject universally saturated, impossible, or mechanically broken scenes using the predeclared U08 criteria. No per-method tuning is allowed.

planned_matrix.statistical_unit: one closed-loop episode identified by scene, fixed goal, diffusion seed, configuration, and stabilizer stratum

planned_analysis.uncertainty: Episode bootstrap clustered and paired by scene/goal_seed/diffusion_seed; with three seeds, results are descriptive if power is inadequate.
planned_analysis.stabilizer_rule: Analyze off and on separately; never pool strata.
planned_analysis.historical_separation: Historical results/research or results/benchmark MuJoCo records must not enter the controlled aggregate.
